# Venue noise tree: results (generated by venue_noise_tree.py; do not edit by hand)

Seed 42. Data: `venue_features` (5,704 real venues). Outcome: high_noise = 1 if >= 3 NYC 311 noise complaints at the address in 3 years.

## Split

| part | rows | high_noise = 1 | rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| train | 3,992 | 683 | 17.1% |
| test | 1,712 | 293 | 17.1% |

## Baseline vs v1 on the test rows

Precision and recall are for the high_noise = 1 class. The baseline never predicts 1, so its precision is 0/0, shown as 0.

| metric | baseline | v1 tree |
|---|---|---|
| accuracy | 0.829 | 0.724 |
| precision | 0.000 | 0.317 |
| recall | 0.000 | 0.532 |
| train accuracy | 0.829 | 0.748 |

Reference, not v1: the same depth-4 tree without class weights (min_samples_leaf 50, tuned on accuracy) scores accuracy 0.829, precision 0.500, recall 0.092 and is worth $1,798.00/month under the same assumptions.

## Confusion matrices (test rows)

| cell | meaning | baseline | v1 tree |
|---|---|---|---|
| TN | actual 0, predicted 0 | 1419 | 1083 |
| FP | actual 0, predicted 1 | 0 | 336 |
| FN | actual 1, predicted 0 | 293 | 137 |
| TP | actual 1, predicted 1 | 0 | 156 |

## v1 settings

max_depth 4, class_weight balanced, min_samples_leaf 20 (chosen by 5-fold CV on train rows, balanced_accuracy), 16 leaves.

| min_samples_leaf | CV mean balanced_accuracy |
|---|---|
| 5 | 0.6519 |
| 10 | 0.6546 |
| 20 | 0.6605 |
| 50 | 0.655 |
| 100 | 0.6536 |

Top feature importances:

| feature | importance |
|---|---|
| lat | 0.370 |
| osm_amenity=bar | 0.286 |
| liquor_tier=beer_wine | 0.165 |
| lon | 0.100 |

| density_250m | 0.003 |

Root split: `osm_amenity=bar <= 0.50` (train high_noise rate 14.8% if yes, 42.1% if no). Full tree: `tree.txt`, `tree.png`.
